messages:
zoe: Kickoff — thinking about a 'local reconciler' pattern for canary/A-B rollouts. Idea: keep decision logic at edge, but add a low-cost central reconciler that watches stamped events and can issue short-lived operator_force keys for widespread issues. Goals: speed, tenant isolation, auditable telemetry, minimal central control. Thoughts? :thinking:

patrick: Like local-first. Edge evaluates on a tick (not per-request), uses EWMA for signals, sets ephemeral override with TTL. Add backoff ladder and require N healthy ticks to clear. Central reconciler watches stamps to detect fleet-wide disagreements and can escalate. Key is to keep central out of normal decision loop.

mina: Major risks: split-brain + autoscaler churn. Mitigations: TTL (30s), backoff [30,60,120], require 3 consecutive healthy ticks, per-tenant token-bucket to limit flips, and node circuit-breaker for hard fallbacks.

watchdog-bot: [lint] local-reconciler-schema v1 OK. INFO: consider min_eval_interval_s for high-churn clusters.

patrick: Sample policy blob:
```json
{
  "schema": "local-reconciler-v1",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "signals": {
    "synthetic_fail_ewma": {"alpha":0.18, "threshold":0.05, "weight":0.6},
    "prod_error_sample_ewma": {"alpha":0.12, "threshold":0.03, "weight":0.3},
    "p99_latency_ewma_ms": {"alpha":0.1, "threshold":1000, "weight":0.1}
  },
  "soft_degrade_score": 0.55,
  "hard_fallback_score": 0.9,
  "ttl_s": 30,
  "backoff_s": [30,60,120],
  "recover_windows": 3,
  "tenant_bucket_capacity": 2,
  "node_hard_fallback_limit_per_hour": 3,
  "operator_force_key": "control-plane.force.local_recon.v1"
}
```

zoe: Observability: add trace header x-local-recon: inst=...,reason=...,policy_rev=..., and metric local_override_total{scope,reason,tenant,inst}. Also emit stamped events with sample_id and window stats.

mina: Ownership: infra owns synthetic probes, EWMA infra, schema hosting; runtime owns domain detectors and weight guidance. Edge policy should accept both classes and default weights to infra-heavy for automated hard_fallbacks.

zoe: Action items: 1) patrick to prototype evaluator & TTL/backoff (PR). 2) infra to publish EWMA lib & probe ownership doc. 3) runtime to map detectors into signals. 4) ops to add trace header & dashboard. Plan a small canary trial with soft_degrades only.

zoe: Also: ensure schema compatible with Dedicated/Private; local agent should accept policy from customer control-plane and honor a customer opt-out for central force keys. :white_check_mark:
